== Notes ==
* This skill can be used to remove enchantments from all of a [[minion master]]'s minions (e.g. [[Death Nova]] or [[Jagged Bones]]), since the game treats them as a [[party]].
* This skill can remove a [[Doublecast skill|doublecast enchantment]] from both the caster and its ally if they are members of the same party.
